title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt and use face masks over time under social influence, policy interventions, and supply constraints, and assess impacts on adoption rates and disease transmission.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: People observe mask use among social contacts and update their adoption decisions based on social norms and tie strengths.

interactions.name: infection_transmission
interactions.description: When people co-locate and interact, infection may transmit with probability modified by mask types and location characteristics.

interactions.name: policy_response
interactions.description: People adjust compliance and mask adoption in response to mandates, messaging, and enforcement actions.

interactions.name: purchase_and_supply
interactions.description: People buy masks from retailers subject to stock and prices; government may subsidize or distribute stock.

interactions.name: household_influence
interactions.description: Within-household norms and shared inventory affect individual adoption and mask availability.

interactions.name: enforcement_event
interactions.description: Locations and authorities enforce mask policies, issuing warnings or penalties that alter future compliance.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Proportion of people wearing any mask at each time step.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until mask adoption first reaches 50% of the population.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum observed adoption rate during the simulation period.

metrics.name: steady_state_adoption
metrics.description: Average adoption over the final window of the simulation indicating equilibrium behavior.

metrics.name: mask_use_by_location_type
metrics.description: Average fraction of masked interactions by location category (e.g., work, retail).

metrics.name: cumulative_infections
metrics.description: Total number of infections over the simulation horizon.

metrics.name: effective_reproduction_number_Rt
metrics.description: Estimated effective reproduction number over time considering mask-mediated transmission reduction.

metrics.name: infection_reduction_pct
metrics.description: Percent reduction in infections relative to a no-mask baseline scenario.

metrics.name: equity_gap_in_adoption
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates between highest and lowest SES quintiles.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_count
metrics.description: Number of warnings or penalties issued for non-compliance.

metrics.name: stockout_frequency
metrics.description: Share of days retailers experience zero stock for any mask type.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_of_adoption
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate change below 1 percentage point for at least 14 consecutive days at the end of the run.

validation_criteria.name: epidemiological_plausibility
validation_criteria.description: With high adoption and high-efficacy masks, Rt should drop below 1 under baseline contacts and parameters.

validation_criteria.name: inventory_nonnegativity
validation_criteria.description: Retailer and household mask inventories must remain non-negative throughout the simulation.

validation_criteria.name: policy_effect_sign
validation_criteria.description: Introducing a strong mandate should not reduce adoption compared to no mandate, holding other factors constant.
